adverse_title: What the worst stress does, quarter by quarter
adverse_story: Revenue falls 20% and the gross margin loses 3 points from the first quarter, and rates rise 200 basis points, on top of the deal.
Net debt / EBITDA peaks at 4.7x in 2026 Q4, above the limit of 3.5x.
Interest cover falls to 3.1x, above the floor of 3.0x.
The first covenant breach comes in 2026 Q4.
Cash stays at USD 924 million or above, with no funding shortfall.
Enterprise value falls by USD 4,952 million, to USD 10,615 million.
For scale: on 18.1% of the simulated paths a covenant breaks, conditional on the assumed model, without this stress being imposed.
